details.question: What does PIRGE predict before inference?
details.answer: These features can be used to predict output tokens, energy, latency, and peak memory before inference. [pirge.txt] PIRGE, or Pre-Inference Reasoning Graph Estimation, converts natural-language prompts into reasoning graphs before model execution. [pirge.txt]

details.question: Why are hypergraphs useful for coordinated IIoT attacks?
details.answer: Hypergraph spectral analysis can model coordinated attacks in Industrial Internet of Things networks. [hypergraph_iiot.txt] Unlike pairwise graphs, hypergraphs represent simultaneous multi-device interactions as hyperedges. [hypergraph_iiot.txt] Normalized hypergraph Laplacian concepts and spectral perturbation analysis can help distinguish benign topology changes from coordinated attack behavior. [hypergraph_iiot.txt] The project connects IIoT security, intrusion detection, cyber-physical systems, network science, hypergraph theory, spectral analysis, and mathematical modeling. [hypergraph_iiot.txt]

details.question: Which metrics are used for model calibration?
details.answer: Model calibration studies whether predicted confidence matches actual correctness. [model_calibration.txt] A model can have high accuracy but still be overconfident, especially under noise or distribution shift. [model_calibration.txt] Calibration diagnostics include Expected Calibration Error, reliability diagrams, class-wise calibration, Brier score, confidence-error coupling, and temperature scaling. [model_calibration.txt] Calibration and overconfidence analysis can compare logistic regression, random forests, and neural networks under clean, noisy, and out-of-distribution settings. [model_calibration.txt]

details.question: How does MOGA-FCM support cognitive load detection?
details.answer: It can reduce high-dimensional wearable physiological features into compact driver-specific subsets for cognitive load detection in ADAS settings. [moga_fcm.txt] MOGA-FCM combines multi-objective genetic algorithm feature selection with Bayesian-optimized Fuzzy C-Means clustering. [moga_fcm.txt] It models overlapping cognitive states as continuous transitions and compares results against clustering baselines. [moga_fcm.txt] Persistent homology, clique filtrations, and topological network descriptors can reveal higher-order structure in brain-state organization under cognitive demand. [eeg_topology.txt]

details.question: How is topology used for EEG functional connectivity?
details.answer: Topological data analysis can study EEG brain dynamics and functional connectivity. [eeg_topology.txt] These methods explore functional connectivity, workload-related changes, and recurrence organization beyond conventional graph summaries. [eeg_topology.txt] Topology-aware EEG analysis can include Neurophysiological Weighted Clique Filtration and Persistent Diagram Recurrence Homology. [eeg_topology.txt] It can reduce high-dimensional wearable physiological features into compact driver-specific subsets for cognitive load detection in ADAS settings. [moga_fcm.txt]
